_comment: The pack's internal English vocabulary, loan-translated into the working language and handed to the human as if it were his language. Each entry carries the pattern that recognises the calque in the sense the pack uses it, and `say` — the plain industry word the reply owed the reader instead, which hooks/midturn-chat-scan.py quotes in its deny so the correction arrives with the replacement already in hand. This list grows by one line every time the human catches a new calque: add a pattern, a replacement, and the sentence that earned it. Every pattern is anchored on the SURROUNDING SENSE rather than the bare word, since each of these words is ordinary Russian on its own — a table has a leg, a fisherman mends a net, a train stops at a station — and a bare-word list would fire on plain speech all day. The seed comes from the 2026-07-27 ~14:47 failure («открытую ногу») plus the pack's own working vocabulary.

calques.note: the pack's word for one acceptance criterion under a requirement. The live failure: «строка 55 честно показывает открытую ногу» (2026-07-27 ~14:47). A table's leg, a chair's leg and a journey's leg stay silent, since the pattern wants the acceptance sense standing beside it.

the pack reads a failing check as going red, which in the working language is a colour word about ripening fruit and blushing people. A tomato ripening in the sun stays silent, since the pattern wants a check word beside the colour.
one step of the build pipeline. A railway station stays silent, since the pattern wants the pipeline word beside it.
the entry point into a package or a skill. Opening the front door of a flat stays silent, since the pattern wants the software object named right after.
the boundary where two components meet. A seam on a jacket stays silent, since the pattern wants the two named components or the architecture word.

the pack calls a check a net. A fisherman mending a net, or a network of shops, stays silent: the pattern wants a verb the pack only ever uses about a check. Judgment call — «сеть ловит» alone is the plainest possible fishing sentence, so the catching form additionally demands a violation word as its object.
the waiting list of items parked for the human's word. A whiteboard in a corridor and a plank of wood stay silent, since the pattern wants the waiting word attached.
